facts.material: aluminum alloy 6061-T6 body and lid, stainless steel spring-ball plunger (aluminum majority by weight/bulk)
facts.function: stores and organizes pills/vitamins in three compartments
facts.form: small lidded box, about 3x1.75x0.75 in and 3.75x2.1x0.9 in, capacity well under 20 liters

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 7612 covers aluminum boxes and similar containers of capacity not exceeding 300 L not fitted with mechanical or thermal equipment; Section XV note 1 and chapter 76 do not exclude it; the plunger is only a lid retainer
GRI 6: 7612.90 other; 7612.90.10 capacity not exceeding 20 L; statistical suffix 90 other (not aerosol, not can)

rejected_alternatives.reason: residual other articles of aluminum; heading 7612 specifically names boxes and similar containers (N348519 junction box is an enclosure, not a container)
steel pillbox provision (K84936); the goods are aluminum, not iron or steel
plastic household articles; goods are aluminum
collapsible tubular containers; these are rigid lidded boxes

classification.rationale: Rigid aluminum lidded pill boxes are aluminum boxes and similar containers under 7612, well under 20 L capacity. N361201 (aluminum cups and lids) was placed in 7612.90.1090; K84936 is the steel-pillbox analog in 7326. The suffix 90 is the residual other under the 20 L line.
